steps.title: Multi-Broker Clustering
steps.text: Surgewave clusters consist of multiple brokers for high availability, scalability, and data locality. Lesson 4.1 covers multi-broker setup and leader election.

steps.title: Data Replication
steps.text: Topics can be replicated across brokers using replication factors, in-sync replicas (ISR), and minimum ISR settings for write durability.

steps.title: Monitoring Stack
steps.text: Monitor Surgewave with Prometheus metrics scraped into Grafana dashboards. Lesson 4.3 walks through setting up the complete observability pipeline.

steps.title: Security Layers
steps.text: Secure your cluster with TLS for transport encryption, SASL for client authentication, and ACLs for fine-grained resource authorization.

steps.title: Architecture Overview
steps.text: Understand how producers, consumers, and brokers work together in a replicated cluster with leader and follower partitions.
